headline:
Everyone blamed Florida
for the condo slowdown.
It's [[happening everywhere]].
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
deck: New data says the slowdown blamed on Florida's insurance bills and HOA reform is happening in nearly every major U.S. market.
pullquote: Condo values have gained just 1% nationwide in four years. Houses gained 6%. That gap showed up in 91 of 97 major markets, not just ours.

stats.label: days the average Florida condo sits unsold

video_second: Not a Florida problem. The new math on condos, everywhere.
